## 4b. Motion quality and task understanding

seam = jump of the commanded end-effector target when a new chunk starts (cm); inside = step-to-step target change within a chunk (cm); seam / inside > 1 = discontinuity at chunk boundaries. accel = mean |second difference| of the target (mm/step^2). toggles = gripper switches per episode. intention = official VLABench intention score (did the robot go for the right object).
